title: REACTOR OPERATOR TRAINING I
description: The Oregon State University TRIGA reactor Operator Training I course culminates in the opportunity to take a certification test proctored by the Nuclear Regulatory Commission.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: NSE 236 and (MTH 256 or 256H).
A minimum grade of C is required in NSE 236, MTH 256 and MTH 256H.
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
meeting_html: MWF 3pm-3:50pm in RC 104C - Radiation Center 104C (9/23 to 12/4)
